configure_logging_json_output: configure Label Studio logging to output JSON-formatted log entries to the console via JSON_LOG env variable
setup_database_postgresql: setup Label Studio to use PostgreSQL as the database backend with environment-configured credentials
configure_cloud_storage_s3: configure Label Studio to use Amazon S3 or MinIO as the cloud file storage backend with bucket and credentials
enable_feature_flags_offline: enable Label Studio feature flags in offline mode with a JSON file for local feature toggles
configure_cors_allowed_origins: configure Label Studio CORS settings to restrict allowed origins to a specific list of URLs
